en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a low, rectangular neoclassical building with arched windows and a central arched entrance labeled "RECORDS" on the frieze above the doorway. The building is surrounded by trees and shrubs, with a dirt road in the foreground and a larger multi‑story civic structure visible behind it. Printed red text at the top identifies the location, and there are bold handwritten cataloging numbers and notes across the sky area.
